In case of DP extension, the awarded seller for the Contract is required to initiate a case for DP Extensio n 3 months prior to End Date of Contract along with revalidated PBG. 2. Quantum of LD:- (a) If the vendor/ contractor fails to supply stores/ goods/ any installment thereof or fails to perform servic es, contract trials, installation of equipment, training and MET (Maintainability Evaluation Trials) as per sch edule specified in a contract will be treated as a breach of contract. (b) in case of inordinate delay {more than one-forth (25%) of the total delivery period}, this maximum ded uction shall be 10% of the total price. .
